@graph.name: Search Intent Rows (Part 3)
@graph.description: Every row of the buyer-intent rubric — 518219 rows generated from the rubric database, never hand-kept — packed as dictionary-encoded columns for the estate API. This file carries part 3 of 4 of the column set: rows 276549–413024 of 518219 in rubric order. The API worker fetches the parts through the dataset distribution path and materializes rows on demand; the bundle no longer embeds the columns. The same rows are published as questions in the answer-evidence dataset and totaled in the intent-coverage dataset. Companion files: datasets-intent-rows.json, datasets-intent-rows-2.json, datasets-intent-rows-3.json, datasets-intent-rows-4.json. The packed columns ride on this node as intentColumns (keyOrder, tables, columns) — estate machine vocabulary on a machine dataset file, by design.
